description: Public prioritization policy for translation QA warnings. Priorities express review urgency, not automatic permission to edit.

P1.meaning: High-value review: likely untranslated text, residual Japanese, or protected runtime-format risk.

P2.meaning: Semantic consistency review: terminology, duplicate-source conflicts, or numeric meaning.

P3.meaning: Low-risk/layout or grandfathered structural debt that should be improved cautiously.

protected-format.recommended_action: Compare source and translation tokens/tags, verify the current authoritative source, then repair only the broken protected syntax.

residual-japanese.recommended_action: Review whether remaining kana is intentional. Translate genuine residue while preserving names, brands, control syntax, and lyric source prefixes.

untranslated-or-intentional.recommended_action: Classify source-equal text as intentional same-form, name/control text, or genuine untranslated content; translate only the latter.

terminology.recommended_action: Review glossary applicability in context. Prefer project terminology unless the Japanese term has a context-specific meaning.

source-consistency.recommended_action: Compare all occurrences of the same Japanese source and decide whether different Chinese outputs are contextual or inconsistent.

display-spacing-variant.recommended_action: Translations differ only by ordinary/NBSP/full-width spacing. Preserve context-specific display layout unless UI evidence shows a defect.

numeric-semantics.recommended_action: Verify numbers/percentages against the current authoritative source before changing the translation. Historical DumpData differences may be stale.

layout.recommended_action: Review line breaks, CR/LF, and NBSP only with UI/rendering context. Do not normalize layout mechanically.

baseline-structure.recommended_action: Verify the original scenario structure before removing a grandfathered duplicate key. Remove the baseline exception when fixed.

baseline-format.recommended_action: This protected-format difference predates the public QA gate. Verify the fixture/source semantics before changing it, and remove the baseline exception when fixed.
